# Abhijeet Gorhe

> Abhijeet Gorhe (Abhijeet Sanjay Gorhe / Abhijeet Rajshree Sanjay Gorhe) is a Computer Science Engineer, full stack developer and video editor from Malegaon, Nashik district, Maharashtra, India. He offers video editing, motion graphics, graphic & web design, software/AI architecture diagrams and AI automation (learning) for YouTubers, creators and local businesses in Nashik, Malegaon and online.

## About
- Location: Malegaon, Nashik district, Maharashtra, India. Serves Nashik city and Malegaon in person, and clients worldwide remotely.
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science, Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli (batch 2022–2026).
- Experience:
  - Full Stack Web Developer Intern, 10xTech (Mumbai), Jul 2026 – present: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, Sequelize, Docker.
  - Web Designer, Rotaract Club of WCE (Sangli), Dec 2022 – Aug 2023: Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop.
  - Content creator and video editor for 2 years; grew his own YouTube channel to 40.7K views and +750 subscribers in 40 days.
- Certification: Java with Full Stack Web Development — SevenMentor Pvt. Ltd. (with Spoken Tutorial, IIT Bombay), issued Jul 2026, ID SM-2026-2N7SX8.
- Project: Digital Payment Management Web App — Node.js, Express.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, JWT.
- Contact: abhijeetgorhe8@gmail.com or the form at https://abhijeetgorhe.me/#contact
